{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Identify the sentinel value used for missing biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Filter for SEVERE patients
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Replace sentinel value with NaN for proper mean calculation
df_severe_clean = df_severe.copy()
df_severe_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = pd.to_numeric(df_severe_clean['biomarker_baseline'], errors='coerce')
df_severe_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = df_severe_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(sentinel_value, pd.NA)

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients, excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker_severe_clean = df_severe_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean(numeric_only=True)

mean_biomarker_severe_clean"}
